reviews.title: Delayed Delivery & Missing Products
reviews.body: I ordered 2 sunscreens during a “Buy 2 Get 1” offer, so I was supposed to receive 3 products in total. The delivery was expected within 4–5 days, but on the delivery date I got an email saying the order was delayed. After sending multiple emails and contacting customer care, the package finally arrived 3–4 days later — but there was only 1 sunscreen in the box. I contacted customer support again, and after nearly 10 days they confirmed they would send the remaining products. That replacement delivery was also delayed, and when it finally arrived, I received 1 sunscreen and 1 moisturizer instead. I still don’t understand why the sunscreen was replaced with a moisturizer. At this point, I just gave up and started using the products I received. The products may be good, but the delivery and order handling experience was honestly very disappointing. If possible, I’d recommend buying from a physical store instead.

reviews.title: Gives a glow
reviews.body: It gives a glow after application. Would it help lighten skin really? Not in my experience Would I use it regularly? Definitely no sunscreen ever. Careful look at its ingredients: Butyl Methoxydibenzoylmethane (Avobenzone): * Role: UVA Filter. ​Endocrine Profile: While generally considered safe by regulatory bodies at standard concentrations, some in vitro studies suggest it can exhibit weak estrogenic activity and potentially disrupt thyroid hormone receptors under specific conditions, particularly when exposed to chlorinated water and UV light simultaneously (forming chlorinated byproducts). ​Ethylhexyl Methoxycinnamate (Octinoxate / Octyl Methoxycinnamate): ​Role: UVB Filter. ​Endocrine Profile: This is the most notable endocrine disruptor in the formula. It has demonstrated significant estrogenic and anti-androgenic activity in multiple in vitro and in vivo animal models. It can mimic estrogen, alter thyroid hormone levels, and impact reproductive hormone signaling. It is highly lipophilic, meaning it readily penetrates the skin barrier and can bioaccumulate. ​Ethylhexyl Salicylate (Octisalate): ​Role: UVB Filter. ​Endocrine Profile: Generally considered a weaker offender than Octinoxate, but some screening assays indicate potential for weak estrogenic activity and interaction with androgen receptors.

reviews.title: Product is amazing but i got a fraud call claiming as Dr Sheth's
reviews.body: Hi Dr. Sheth's team, I ordered products from Dr Sheth's website and it got delivered on time yesterday. But before delivering i received a fraud call that the order has been delayed for 20-25 days and to receive it within 24 hours I need to do a repay the amount again. They had all the information about my address, order, amount of order everything. This is not acceptable that our (customer's) private information are getting leaked with such a fraudsters. It should be Dr Sheth's team responsibility to protect our personal data and keep an eye on such data bridges. I hope you will understand the sensitivity of our data getting leaked. FYI, the number from where I got a fraud call yesterday: 98362 23755 Thanks!
